notes: ACCESS: robots.txt returned 404 (no file present, not a block) so no tier restriction. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome120) worked and returned a fully server-rendered mega-menu (all /products/<cat>/<subcat>/ URLs visible in raw HTML), so the full category tree was built from tier (a) alone. However the product-listing grids and totals on each category page are client-rendered (empty in raw HTML) so quantities required escalation to tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium, networkidle wait). TREE METHOD: union of homepage mega-menu (Sofas/Furniture/Kitchen/Textile/Lighting/Accessories/Outdoor/Art/Brand kit/Add ons) plus each category page's own left-nav category strip; no sitemap.xml/sitemap_index.xml existed (404) so mega-menu was the sole tree source; every candidate page's breadcrumb (All Products > Parent > Node) was checked and matched the requested slug on every leaf recorded. QTY METHOD: rendered <span class="totalcount"> element on each category listing page after Playwright networkidle load (verified against the visible product-card list on low-count pages). EXCLUDED: Sofas, Furniture (benches/cabinets-shelves/dining-chairs/dining-tables/fauteuils/side-tables/stools - all under the Furniture nav, cabinets-shelves=28 explicitly excluded from Storage per storage.md S21 since site places it under Furniture), Kitchen ceramics/tableware/glassware/mugs-cups/plates/bowls/cutlery/kitchen-accessories(132)/serveware-display (Kitchen & Dining, out of scope), Lighting (all subcats), Accessories clocks/candle-holders/home-fragrances/flowerpots/mirrors/objects-sculptures/vases/wall-decoration (Decorative Home Accessories/Wall Decor, out of scope), Outdoor furniture and outdoor-accessories(4: umbrellas+floor vase - Decorative/Outdoor furniture, not textile/storage), Art, Brand kit and Add ons (dealer-login-gated pages, zero public products), Collections/Catalogues/Fresh stock (collection & seasonal landing pages, not category pages). Textile.wall-rugs (2) verified as genuine woven fabric wall tapestries ('Wall rug sunrise/sundown') = Textile per textile.md S14. Outdoor.outdoor-textile (2) verified as fabric hammocks ('Hammock peach/olive'), classified Textile (fabric outdoor product, site's own category name is Outdoor textile) per textile.md S12. Kitchen.table-linen (21) verified as napkins/tablecloths/tea towels = Textile per textile.md S7/S8; recorded as a standalone leaf (not nested under the Textile group) since it lives under the site's Kitchen nav branch, not the Textile nav branch. Accessories.clothing-racks (1, 'Chubby clothing rack with hangers brass') classified Storage per storage.md S19 (Clothes Racks explicitly listed as included storage item); site places it under Accessories, not Furniture, so no Furniture-boundary override applies - confidence MEDIUM given it is a single freestanding rack product. No dedicated Storage/Organization category or storage boxes/baskets/bins/organizers/hampers found anywhere in the nav (grepped homepage HTML for storage/basket/organiz/crate/trunk/hamper/laundry - only false-positive matches were cookie-consent JS strings like 'functional_storage').
